blocks.text: Population survivorship kisi umr par zinda group ka feesad hai, jo survivorship curves se dikhaya jata hai jin mein y-axis par bache hue aur x-axis par umr hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Umr ke muqable mein bache hue afraad ki tadaad ka graph. Type I (neela) ooncha rehta phir aakhir mein tezi se girta, jaise insan aur bohat se mammals. Type II (hara) seedhi tirchhi lakeer, jaise parinde, chhipkaliyan aur rodents. Type III (surkh) foran tezi se gir kar seedha ho jata, jaise machhliyan aur bohat se invertebrates.
blocks.caption: Survivorship curves (Figure 25.7 ke mutabiq asal graph).
blocks.long_description: Survivorship kisi group ka woh feesad hai jo kisi umr par zinda ho, umr ke muqable mein bache hue afraad ka graph. Type I (convex) aabadiyon mein zyada tar afraad budhape tak jeete phir jaldi marte hain; mahol ka maut par kam asar hota hai. Type II (diagonal) aabadiyon mein maut ka imkaan saari zindagi aik jaisa hai. Type III (concave) aabadiyon mein bachpan ki amwaat bohat zyada hain, lekin jawani tak pohanchne walon ki maut ki sharah kaafi kam hai.

blocks.text: Aabadi ki barhotri waqt ke saath afraad ki tadaad ka izafa hai. Exponential model mein aabadi apni zyada se zyada raftaar se, har waqt ki ikai mein aik hi nisbat se, baghair had barhti hai; har aabadi aisa nahi dikhati. Logistic model mein aabadi aakhir hudood, yaani jagah, roshni, paani ya ghizai ajza ki kami, se milti aur apne maskan ki carrying capacity par thehar jati hai, jis se S shakal (sigmoid) curve banta hai.

blocks.alt: Waqt ke muqable mein aabadi ke do graphs. Baen, exponential: J shakal ka curve jo baghair had ke tez se tez barhta. Daen, logistic: S shakal ka curve jo barh kar carrying capacity likhi dashed lakeer par ruk jata.
blocks.caption: Exponential aur logistic barhotri (Figure 25.8 ke mutabiq asal graphs).
blocks.long_description: Exponential model mein aabadi apni zyada se zyada raftaar se baghair had barhti, har waqt ki ikai mein aik hi nisbat se, aur J shakal ka curve banta hai; har aabadi aisa nahi dikhati. Logistic model mein jagah, roshni, paani ya ghizai ajza kam hone par barhotri dheemi hoti aur aabadi apne maskan ki carrying capacity par ruk jati hai, jis se sigmoid, chapta S shakal ka curve banta hai.

blocks.text: Aabadi ki kasafat fi ikai raqba ya hajm afraad ki tadaad hai, jaise Muzaffarabad mein fi murabba kilometre shehtoot ke darakht ya test tube mein fi millilitre E. coli. Carrying capacity ke qareeb zyada kasafat ka matlab sakht muqabla, kam paidaish, zyada amwaat aur zyada aaloodgi hai.

blocks.alt: Nuqton ke teen murabba qitaat. Random: be-tarteeb bikhre nuqte, jaise hawa se bikhre beej. Uniform: qataron mein barabar faasle par nuqte, jaise ilaqa rakhne wale ghonsla banate penguins. Clumped: teen ghane guchhon mein nuqte, bikhre wasail ya group mein rehne se, sab se aam namoona.
blocks.caption: Random, uniform aur clumped phailao (is topic ke liye asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Dispersion batata hai ke aabadi mein afraad kaise phaile hain. Random spacing mein afraad aapas mein zyada amal nahi karte; yeh kam hai, maslan aise paudon mein jin ke hawa se bikhre beej jahan giren wahin ug jate hain. Uniform spacing mein afraad barabar faasle par hote hain, jaise jab paude qareeb ugne se rokte ya ghonsla banate penguins jaise janwar ilaqa rakhte hain. Clumped spacing, fitrat mein sab se aam, mein afraad wasail ki jagah jama hote ya group mein rehte hain, jaise seedhe neeche beej girane wale paude.

items: Random spacing: afraad aapas mein zyada amal nahi karte; kam milta, kuch paudon mein jin ke hawa se bikhre beej jahan giren ug jate.
Uniform spacing: afraad barabar faasle par, jaise jab paude qareeb ugne se rokte ya ghonsla banate penguins jaise janwar ilaqa rakhte.
Clumped spacing: afraad groups ya guchhon mein, kyunke wasail bikhre hain ya janwar group mein rehte; sab se aam namoona, seedhe neeche beej girane wale paudon mein.

blocks.text: 5. Carrying capacity aur 6. kam se kam qabil-e-baqa aabadi

Carrying capacity kisi species ke afraad ki woh zyada se zyada tadaad hai jise mahol lambe arse tak mustaqil sahara de sake, jo khana, paani, panah aur ghonslon ki jaghon jaise mehdood karne wale awamil aur shikari aur bimariyon se tay hoti hai. Kam se kam qabil-e-baqa aabadi woh sab se kam tadaad hai jo aabadi ke qaim rehne ke liye zaroori ho; is se neeche maadoomi ka khatra zyada hai, kyunke aapas ki shadiyan (inbreeding) aabadi aur us ki qowwat-e-mudafiat kamzor karti hain (jaise Pakistan ke bache hue chand Himalayan bhoore reechh) aur aik sailab ya jangal ki aag ise mita sakti hai.

blocks.title: Aath billion ka din
blocks.text: Duniya ki aabadi ko 7 se 8 billion hone mein 12 saal lage aur 2022 mein 8 billion hui. Kitab kehti hai ke 9 billion tak pohanchne mein taqreeban 15 saal (2037 tak) lagenge, aur 2050 tak yeh taqreeban 10 billion hogi, zyada tar taraqqi pazeer ilaqon mein.
